newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO's Abu Mazen meets Israeli lawmakers.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Abu Mazen meets Israeli lawmakers.

text.p: Two leading Israeli legislators met in Jerusalem with senior PLO official Mahmoud Abbas, including the leader of a party that is a member of the ruling hardline coalition.

Haim Ramon, a contender to succeed Shimon Peres as head of Israel's opposition Labour party, said on Thursday that he met Abbas, better known as Abu Mazen, along with Shas party leader Aryeh Deri on Wednesday.
"The meeting centred on the political situation, on political negotiations, on what will happen in the future...It is important that these meetings take place," Ramon told the Israel Radio.
Deri's Shas party is a key component in Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's rightist-religious coalition government. Shas was also a partner in the Labour-led government ousted in May.
